info.title: Ritten
info.description: A command line tool for running portable CI/CD workflows.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show every log entry in its highest detail. [default: False]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Show each step's outcome, but only failure detail. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Rehearse the job without pushing, tagging, releasing, or commenting. [default: False]

options.name: --auto-approve
options.description: Approve a job up front, for runs with nobody there to confirm. [default: False]

commands.name: status
commands.description: Reports where the project stands: version, release state, and changelog.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Compiles and tests, without any release checks.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Checks a pull request: formatting, version, changelog, compile, tests, and pack.

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Checks, packs, tags, creates the GitHub release, and publishes to NuGet.
